mapper.select: SELECT oprtr_id , ownr_nm , rfid_no , CAST(AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(oprtr_nm), 'theimc') AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET UTF8MB4) AS oprtr_nm , lbl , reg_dt , mdfcn_dt FROM cmm_oprtr_rfid_info WHERE 1=1 AND rfid_no = #{rfidNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT SUBSTRING(oprtr_id, 3) AS last_seq FROM cmm_oprtr_rfid_info WHERE oprtr_id LIKE CONCAT(#{oprtrPrefix}, '%') AND LENGTH(oprtr_id) = 6 ORDER BY oprtr_id desc LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM svc_opr_rfid_data WHERE 1=1 AND rfid_no = #{rfidNo}
AND tag_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt}, ' 00:00:00') AND tag_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDt}, ' 23:59:59')
